Payload.$Comment: Keeps every mob Mob Scaling scales in the Shifting Deep's tier 1 (MMO Skill Tree's dungeon Shifting_Deep) between level 10 and level 20. Each copy of a CommonLib dungeon is a world named after the dungeon's file, a dash and the copy's number (shifting_deep-1, shifting_deep-2 and so on), so this pattern reaches every copy of tier 1 and none of tier 2's, tier 3's or the daily's, whose names carry more after Deep before the dash. Floor is the level a mob starts at: a dungeon copy is a void world with no zone or biome, so this world floor is the one that applies there. Its mobs' health and damage stay at that level, and a nearby group's power raises the level they roll their rarity, affixes and casters at; MinCap and MaxCap clamp that, so 20 is as high as it goes and 10 as low. Set OpenWorld.GroupDeltaStatShare to let a share of the group's power raise health and damage too. DistanceEscalation is off so an area's distance from the copy's spawn point adds nothing, and PlayerScalingStartRingBlocks is 0 so a group's power counts from the first block. To move the band, set Floor and MinCap to the new bottom and MaxCap to the new top; add "Enabled": false to switch scaling off in this tier entirely. Party is off: the dungeon already brings more foes for a bigger party, so its mobs do not also grow tougher with the players near them.
